description: Read-only MCP server exposing the MPP service discovery catalog and payment terms as advisory MCP tools.
instructions: Use this read-only MCP server to discover MPP paid API services and payment terms from https://mpp.dev/api/services. Call list_services for a catalog overview, search_services to filter providers, search_offers to find payable endpoints, recommend_services to rank services for an agent task, get_usage_recipe to turn a chosen service into next MCP and HTTP steps, get_facets to inspect valid filters, get_services_by_recipient to map a payment recipient to services, get_catalog_status to inspect freshness, get_service for a full service record, get_offers for endpoint payment offers, and get_openapi for a service OpenAPI document or registry-derived endpoint view. Discovery is advisory; the runtime 402 Challenge is authoritative. This server does not register services, execute payments, authorize requests, or replace runtime 402 Challenge validation.
